text:
Zoe (AE): Handoff for Hospix Labs — signed today. Deployment: Dedicated, prefer us-east-2. Requirements: SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit log export to their SIEM, and strict data residency. Pilot: 5 clinician seats starting next week with potential ramp in 6 weeks. Renewal noted in Q1 next year; procurement timeline could be a renewal risk if onboarding slips >21 days. Need CSM owner and a clear CS->eng escalation path.

Priyanka (CSM): Ill take CSM. Can someone drop the AWS account ID and SAML metadata here? Also want their top-10 prompts and a primary clinical use-case for evals. Planning a 45m enablement + security walk-through.

Marcus (Infra SE): Staging cluster is deployed in dedicated-useast2. Missing their VPC CIDR and SAML metadata. I'll prepare an infra checklist (SGs, route table, NACL notes) and a small footprint matrix for model variants. Will also propose int8 quant for pilot to keep costs down.

Hana (Support): Creating ticket now: <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/9988|ticket-9988>. Tags: hospix, dedicated, siem, kms. Assigning to Marcus + infra-team. ETA triage 4h. audit-bot will publish compliance checklist here. :gear:

audit-bot: Required docs noted: DPA signed, SOC2-type evidence, KMS key policy template. DPA must be on file before PHI ingestion.

Zoe (AE): Customer contact: ops@hospixlabs.com, AWS acct 222333444555. They requested enablement Fri 11am ET; prefer a short smoke test beforehand. They asked specifically about cost controls (batching, prefix cache) and an audit log retention policy. Priyanka - include Optimize guidance in the session.

Priyanka (CSM): Scheduling tentative Fri 11am ET. Owners so far: Priyanka = onboarding/enablement; Marcus = infra & peering; Hana = support triage & smoke test; Zoe = sales escalation + DPA follow-up. No objections.

Marcus (Infra SE): Peering snippet I'll add to ticket-9988. Example for their side:

```
# Customer route to accept peering
Destination: 10.90.0.0/16
Target: pcx-0e9f8d7c6b
```

Marcus (Infra SE): Also adding recommended SGs and a note to enable prefix KV cache for frequent clinician templates. I'll upload model memory/latency numbers to help Priyanka size sessions.

Hana (Support): ticket-9988 created and linked to onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/hospix. Marking demo blocked until peering + SAML metadata validated. I'll run smoke test and post results here once ready. :white_check_mark:

Priyanka (CSM): I'll collect their prompt set and clinician workflows ahead of the enablement. After the demo I'll send a 3-question NPS + feedback form and capture any quality regressions for Research. Also adding renewal_watch tag in CRM because procurement timeline is tight.

Zoe (AE): Procurement note: their security lead wants log-forwarding proof before full ingest. I can escalate legal/DPA if needed. Also they asked about an SLA for 99.9% availability for production — Marcus, can we prep a short note on expected latencies/availability targets for Dedicated?

Marcus (Infra SE): Will draft a short note on availability targets and expected p95 latency for pilot. Action items recap: 1) Hana -> create/triage ticket-9988 and validate peering. 2) Marcus -> upload SG/route snippets + availability note. 3) Priyanka -> send invite & enablement deck, collect prompts. 4) Zoe -> DPA + security follow-up. Post-demo: Priyanka to circulate feedback and open any research tickets for regressions. Ping here if anything blocks.
